app.name: Mail Warden
maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.subtitle: Product updates, package updates, slave upgrades, and runtime moves for this server.
cluster.runtimeHelp: Running, new-install, and latest long-term lines. These buttons start the move. They stay planned until WARDEN_ALLOW_HOST_UPDATE=1.
platform.subtitle: Environments for this console.
platform.name: Name
role.admin.help: Full control, including policy and service configuration.
role.operator.help: Operates mail: can show all mail, release, and bypass. Cannot edit policy or service configuration.
login.hero.title: Hold the mail that should not land.
login.hero.subtitle: Policy, quarantine, and identity for the mail path.
login.hero.highlight2: Release with a fresh policy decision
login.hero.highlight3: Operators can bypass, and that choice is audited
login.title: Sign in
login.cardDescription: Use a local account, directory, or identity provider.
login.twoFactorDescription: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator.
login.passwordDescription: This account must set a new password before it can continue.
login.setupDescription: Scan the address or enter the secret, then confirm a code.
login.toast.setup2fa: Set up an authenticator to finish
dashboard.title: Pulse
dashboard.subtitle: Mail counters and the newest messages you can see.
messages.title: Messages
messages.subtitle: Decisions recorded for mail you are allowed to see.
quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.subtitle: Held mail. A rescan uses the current policy on the stored decision.
quarantine.rescanConfirm: Run the stored decision through the current policy. The hold is released only if the new decision allows delivery.
quarantine.bypassConfirm: Skip the policy pass, release the Postfix hold, and write an audit event.
policy.title: Policy
policy.subtitle: Thresholds, hard blocks, and signal caps. Saving updates the live engine and stores a version.
policy.diskNote: Save and rollback change the live process. The on-disk policy YAML file is not rewritten.
policy.rollbackConfirm: Replace the live policy with this version. The YAML file on disk stays as it is.
identity.title: Identity providers
identity.subtitle: Local, LDAP, and OIDC providers used by the sign-in page.
events.title: Events
events.subtitle: Message events recorded by the policy path.
metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.subtitle: Process counters. Prometheus text stays on /metrics.
configuration.title: Service configuration
configuration.subtitle: Secrets stay blank until you type a new value. Listen address, database, and token secrets apply on the next process start.
configuration.restart: Saved. These fields need a process restart before they apply:
configuration.live: Saved. Live settings were applied to this process.
users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Three roles. Operator is the moderator role.
cluster.title: Slave Nodes
cluster.subtitle: Nodes that have sent a heartbeat.
snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.subtitle: Stored configuration documents. Applying one uses the same policy and service updates as the editors.
snapshots.applyConfirm: Apply this snapshot to the live process. Policy snapshots do not rewrite the YAML file.
